poster_talking_points: Compare three strategies on compiled CNOTs: from-scratch raw RL, ADAPT→compile→prune, hybrid Givens→prune.
H2: raw RL wins (3 CNOTs, exact FCI).
LiH: raw RL from scratch fails; symmetry in action space (Givens) hits 14 CNOT floor; pruning ADAPT compile gets 23 (greedy) or ~12 (RL, in progress).
Honest negative: unconstrained raw gates do not scale to 8q LiH without paper-scale training.
